## Setup

- **Resolution / aspect:** (e.g. 3440x1440, 21:9)
- **OS:** Linux (distro) / Windows / Steam Deck
- **Launcher:** Steam / Heroic / Lutris / Bottles / other
- **Proton / Wine version:** (n/a on Windows)
- **Game build:** (Steam > Properties > Updates shows the build id)
- **Other mods:** none / list them (ReShade, dinput8 loader, nativePC texture packs, …)

## What works

- [ ] The image fills the monitor (no black bars)
- [ ] Field of view is wider, nothing cut at the top or bottom
- [ ] HUD stays inside a centred 16:9 area (minimap, health, action palette)
- [ ] Menus, inventory and map look right
- [ ] Borderless window (game set to Windowed)

## What doesn't

Describe the scene, attach a screenshot, and paste `DDDAFix.log` from the game folder.
